# Team guidelines for the agent (example)

Replace this text with your own rules. `aihub` and the generic skills tell the agent to read the files listed under
`guidelines:` in `team.yaml` before it writes code or text.

- Write pull requests and stories in Dutch, following the templates.
- One topic per pull request; no unrelated formatting changes.
- Name branches `feature/<story id>-<slug>`.
- Mention what was not tested instead of leaving it out.
